## Context / Problem

6 high CodeQL alerts are open on navapbc/rebar `main` (analysis of 7ea86184): 4 `py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data` (#89, #90, #91, #94) and 2 `py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization` (#92, #93). Found by the 2026-11-02 read-only ops sweep. Each alert was traced through the analysis SARIF code flows to decide what data actually reaches the sink.

Verdicts:

- **#89** `_cli/_workflow_commands.py:214` and **#90** `:288` — TRUE POSITIVE. Source: the `_scan_secret_literals()` and `secret_scan()` findings in `llm/workflow/lint.py`. Each finding message embeds `_redact(value)`, which prints the first 3 and last 3 characters of any value longer than 8 characters. For a short literal password in a credential-named `with:` field that is most of the value, written to stdout/stderr (and CI logs) by `rebar workflow validate` / `new`. This breaks the repo's own rule from bug e7a9 (`rebar.secret_screen`): diagnostics carry only family, field path and line, no value-derived material.
- **#92** `tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py:182` — TRUE POSITIVE (weak guard). The test's intent is that the acli binary is downloaded from Atlassian's host, but `"acli.atlassian.com" in text` also accepts `https://evil.example/?x=acli.atlassian.com` or `https://acli.atlassian.com.evil.example/...`. Same class the repo fixed in code under 77b5-be18-6395-4984 and 1086-ca69-007b-4732.
- **#91** `_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py:457` — FALSE POSITIVE. The flagged `anthropic_api_key` / `openai_api_key` report fields are `bool(os.environ.get(...))` presence flags from `llm.config.available_backends()`; only True/False is printed. CodeQL flags the dict key name.
- **#93** `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py:232` — FALSE POSITIVE. `result.stderr` is the guard script's diagnostic text, not a URL; the assertion checks that the message names the forbidden token from `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` `FORBIDDEN_ACTION_TEXT`. No URL is sanitized or trusted.
- **#94** `_config_coercion.py:91` — FALSE POSITIVE. The sink logs an unknown `[llm]` config KEY NAME. CodeQL's flow starts at test fixtures' `SECRET_ENV` strings (env-var NAMES, not secrets) under the `mcp` section and reaches the `[llm]` path only by ignoring the `sect == "llm"` guard in `_config_sections.coerce_sparse` and conflating dict values with keys.

## Approach

1. `llm/workflow/lint.py`: drop `_redact` and every value-derived fragment from both credential findings; messages keep the family label / field path / line and say the value is not shown (the e7a9 convention). Rename the private `_scan_secret_literals` to `_scan_credential_literals`, move the shape scan body into a private `_credential_shape_findings`, and keep public `secret_scan` as a thin wrapper so the exported API (`rebar.llm.workflow.secret_scan`) is unchanged. `lint_workflow` calls the private helpers. The rename is needed because CodeQL treats a call to a function named `*secret*` as a sensitive source regardless of content (same reshape-so-CodeQL-sees-the-fix precedent as 06de-6269-34dd-4109).
2. `tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py`: replace the substring assert with a helper that extracts the acli `curl` download URL(s) from `Dockerfile.mcp`, parses each with `urllib.parse.urlsplit`, and asserts scheme `https` and `hostname == "acli.atlassian.com"`.
3. False positives (#91, #93, #94): no code change and no in-code suppression (the repo has no CodeQL suppression-comment pattern). Evidence is recorded on this ticket; dismissal on GitHub is an operator action.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/lint.py` — redaction removal and helper renames.
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_lint.py` — no-value-leak tests for both credential checks.
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_cli.py` — `workflow validate` text and JSON output carry no value fragment.
- `tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py` — parsed-host acli assertion plus crafted-URL rejection tests.

No `src/rebar` file exceeds 800 lines; no function's complexity increases; no new mechanism.

## Testing

Written first and shown failing on current code:

- Happy path: a workflow with `password: hunter2xyzq` and one with an AWS-key shape still produce their findings (family / field named).
- Leak check: neither the full value nor its 3-character head or tail appears in any finding message, in `rebar workflow validate` text output, or in `--output json`.
- Edge: a value of 8 characters or fewer (already masked) still produces a finding.
- #92: the real `Dockerfile.mcp` passes; crafted texts with `https://evil.example/?x=acli.atlassian.com`, `https://acli.atlassian.com.evil.example/...`, `http://acli.atlassian.com/...`, and no acli curl line are each rejected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Workflow lint credential findings contain no value-derived characters, proven by tests on `lint_workflow`, `secret_scan`, and `rebar workflow validate` (text and JSON).
- [x] Public `rebar.llm.workflow.secret_scan` still exists and still flags credential shapes.
- [x] The acli download-host test parses the URL with `urllib.parse` and rejects crafted lookalike URLs, proven by tests.
- [x] Targeted tests, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` pass in the worktree venv.
- [x] The change merges through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
- [x] [non-codebase] After the merge is analysed, `gh api repos/navapbc/rebar/code-scanning/alerts` shows #89, #90 and #92 closed.
  provenance: environment=github code-scanning (navapbc/rebar); principal=gh CLI user; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read `gh api repos/navapbc/rebar/code-scanning/alerts/{89,90,92}` on 2026-11-04: each has state=fixed with fixed_at 2026-11-04T06:44:12Z.
- [x] [non-codebase] #91, #93 and #94 are dismissed on GitHub with the recorded reason (operator action; agents make no GitHub writes).
  provenance: environment=github code-scanning (navapbc/rebar); principal=gh CLI user; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read `gh api repos/navapbc/rebar/code-scanning/alerts/{91,93,94}` on 2026-11-04: each has state=dismissed, dismissed_reason="false positive", dismissed 2026-11-04T17:48:55-58Z by the operator account, with an evidence comment; the open high-severity alert list is empty.
